en: A black and white postcard image showing an architectural complex by a large reflecting pool or water feature. The central structure has a steeply pitched roof and symmetrical flanking buildings, likely designed in a monumental or exhibition style. On the right side of the image is another building topped by a large, spherical object with orbit-like rings, suggesting a science or planetary motif. There are a few flags atop the main structures, and some arranged trees and landscaping in the foreground.
